title: Draft qualified report — Halvorsen Marine
instructions: Halvorsen Marine, a private company, didn't capitalize leases as required by U.S. GAAP. The effect is material but not pervasive. Review the draft report excerpts and correct any errors.

- All other matters were resolved satisfactorily.
